Confirmed argument unused; exact bullish requires RED else GREEN. Test wrong tag first, then analysis None; either rejects without lower queries. No separate validation of direction or candle identity.

No hit: read full main interval open to open+timeframe via seconds_between; materialize list, reject empty. Not merely post-event remainder; observed rows not proof of complete coverage.

Bullish evaluate max key (High, negative native epoch float) before min (Low, datetime). Python max/min keep first encountered equal full key; epoch rounding/timezone semantics may collapse distinct timestamps, no Decimal price coercion.
Nonbullish evaluate min Low/datetime first then max High/negative epoch; same tie rules but evaluation order differs, failures propagate.

supplemental.historical: Base initialization precedes output direction and initial trend flag storage; no local validation of those flags/direction. Fresh per-direction lists, geometry/gate caches and null helpers/checkpoints; lazy creation only on access.
Bull and bear properties independently initialize once on null; same original arrays and detector bounds, no eager dual instantiation.

Anchor eligibility requires Break, anchor, immediate adjacency and nonempty direction Reset list; use last recorded Reset index, opposite detector from that index to First. Any opposite Break equal anchor establishes confirmation; not a time-sorted re-selection.

Confirmed anchor can replace confirmation-side price/source on exact inequality (bearish anchor High<=First High, otherwise anchor Low>=First Low). No separate price comparison against existing box edge; do not invent shrink guard from comment.

Nonnull Break recomputes outward edge inclusive First..Break. Only Break-owned extreme and nonnull exact analysis replace price/source, including confirming lower row under RE10/25. No hit retains full main geometry. Null Break skips recompute but still appends shallow copy and returns true; caller owns confirmation validity.
Append reset uses supplied main index/display, optional second display, level and previous First; no deduplication in helper, no exact-event validation.

Nonbullish selects bearish analysis; only exact bearish mutates top and exact bullish mutates bottom, separate guards. Null returns before any mutation. Nonnull analysis returned even if no ownership match.

Correct First tag and nonnull analysis required; search strictly later datetime (+1us) to exclusive main end against analysis.extreme, not confirmed argument (unused). Any nonnull outward hit rejects. Otherwise read whole Break interval, reject empty.

Top uses max(High,-timestamp.timestamp()) where epoch float conversion is native, not exact Decimal price conversion; bottom uses min(Low,datetime). Bull top then bottom, nonbull bottom then top; equal full keys retain first encountered row. Candidate provenance both edges current main, full lower prices, intrabar start main open, mode B; no claim of arbitrary timezone-independent earliest timestamp.
